titulo_ja: に ちがいない と とは かぎらない

bloques.titulo: It is a firm conclusion; it is a clear sign that something is not always true.
texto: The two constructions look at the evidence differently: one reinforces a deduction; the other limits a generalization.
The room is dark and there are no lights. I'm sure there's no one there.)
The product is not necessarily of good quality.

frases.ja: へや が くらくて、 でんき も ついて いません。 だれも いない に ちがいありません。
frases.es: La habitación está oscura y no hay luces. Seguro que no hay nadie.
frases.en: The room is dark and there are no lights. I'm sure there's no one here.

frases.ja: ねだん が たかい から と いって、 せいひん の しつ が いい と は かぎりません。
frases.es: Que el producto sea caro no significa necesariamente que sea de buena calidad.
frases.en: The cost of the product does not necessarily mean that it is of good quality.
